name: Sunview Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sunview 完成了对一座50兆瓦大型太阳能光伏电站的收购，并推进收购 JSNT 及业务多元化计划；同时出售其在 Winstar Capital Berhad 的22.44%股权，并终止了与 Huawei 的谅解备忘录。公司通过多次新股发行进行融资。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunview completed the acquisition of a 50 MW large-scale solar PV power plant and progressed the proposed acquisition of JSNT and business diversification; it also disposed of its 22.44% equity interest in Winstar Capital Berhad and terminated the MOU with Huawei. The company raised funds through multiple new share issuances.

segments.name: 太阳能发电与供应
segments.note: 公司完成收购一座50兆瓦大型太阳能光伏电站，并推进收购JSNT以扩展发电业务。
segments.note_en: The company completed the acquisition of a 50 MW large-scale solar PV power plant and progressed the acquisition of JSNT to expand power generation.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购JSNT的完成期限延长至2027年5月31日。
actions.text_en: The completion deadline for the acquisition of JSNT was extended to 31 May 2027.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: SAM 2 与 PKNP 及 PKNP Reneuco 签订更替协议，承接太阳能电站租赁协议。
actions.text_en: SAM 2 entered into a novation agreement with PKNP and PKNP Reneuco to assume the Solar Plant Lease Agreement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以6300万令吉收购一座50兆瓦大型太阳能光伏电站，交易已完成。
actions.text_en: Acquired a 50 MW large-scale solar PV power plant for RM63.0 million; the acquisition was completed.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面进行了资产出售、谅解备忘录终止及多项融资活动。
segments.note_en: At the group level, there were asset disposals, termination of an MOU, and multiple fundraising activities.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 终止与Huawei Technologies (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.的谅解备忘录。
actions.text_en: Terminated the Memorandum of Understanding with Huawei Technologies (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以约3010万令吉出售Winstar Capital Berhad的22.44%股权，交易已完成。
actions.text_en: Disposed of a 22.44% equity interest in Winstar Capital Berhad for approximately RM30.1 million; the disposal was completed.

actions.title: NEW ISSUE OF SECURITIES (CHAPTER 6 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : FUND RAISING
actions.text: 进行新股发行以筹集资金。
actions.text_en: Undertook a new issue of securities for fundraising.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购50兆瓦太阳能电站，扩大太阳能发电与供应业务。
model_changes.text_en: Expanded the solar power generation and supply business through the acquisition of a 50 MW solar plant.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 出售Winstar Capital Berhad的22.44%股权，退出该投资。
model_changes.text_en: Disposed of a 22.44% equity interest in Winstar Capital Berhad, exiting the investment.
